title: Bills of lading
definition: The transport documents for a shipment, showing what was shipped, the quantity, the route and the parties. They are requested where the declared value of a trade has to be tested against what physically moved, and they establish existence and movement of goods, which a set of invoices does not.
evidence_to_cite: the bill of lading, with the carrier, the vessel or vehicle and the ports
the quantity and description of the goods, against the invoiced quantity
the shipper and the notify party, against the parties on the invoice

sources.citation: Shipping and customs documentation supporting the assessment of trade-based activity, summarised in the FinCrime regulatory index.
